verified.exploit_entry_point: The HTTP upload and resumable-upload handlers of package http, driven through the product's own handle() wrapper with a real bolt storage backend and a signed JWT for a user scoped to /user.
sites: files/file.go:186-228 (WithinScope: existence-based resolution admits a dangling link whose target escapes)
http/tus_handlers.go:90-100 (resumable creation follows it before the post-open check)
routes: advisory route only: upload and resumable upload creation through a symlink inside the scope whose target is outside it, absolute, relative, or through a symlinked component before a '..'

traps.shape: the shared containment predicate must decide where a write would really land: a dangling link's target (absolute or relative), further links, and a '..' that applies after a symlinked component, while brand-new files and links that resolve inside the scope keep working
traps.reason_to_dismiss: a single link read plus a lexical prefix check looks complete
traps.realistic_because: published fix site; the control keeps only the route the report leads to

patch_checks.why: blind fix produced by run_blindfix after the first gate

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: a panic or 500 in the resolver aborts the request; every tested route maps a plain refusal to a client error
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the containment rule inspects the path the request actually writes, with no proxy object to confuse it
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: no roles, peers or request directions exist on this surface
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the control's protected operation is a write; no read surface is exercised
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the only adjustment is link resolution, and a correct fix resolves before deciding
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: containment is decided from the filesystem, with no authority or secret lookup that could fail open
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the control changes one internal predicate; its contract (true = confined) is unchanged

status: control built; all gate stages passed on 2026-10-23 (static, nop 4/4 security fail + 65/65 functional pass, oracle 3x reward 1.0, patches 3/3 declared outcomes)
